body: Proprietary agent personas, role contracts, and system instructions constitute core enterprise IP. Shipping them as raw markdown or JSON on customer filesystems (on-prem/OEM) exposes Product Forge's competitive reasoning logic to reverse engineering and direct extraction. This item establishes the asset compiler and runtime decryptor to keep prompt IP secure.
_note: Full authoring of context, epic, and ACs

brief.problem: Agent system instructions, system prompts, and tool calling definitions are currently stored as plaintext or markdown files, creating high vulnerability to reverse-engineering, prompt extraction, and IP theft in on-prem and edge distributions.
brief.what_adds: Prompt and Persona Asset Compiler providing offline tokenization, bytecode encryption, and runtime decrypt-on-invocation for proprietary LLM instructions.

label: PF Backlog 685
risks: Key management complexity in air-gapped sovereign environments mitigated via licensing key derivation.
title: Prompt and Persona Asset Compiler: secure compilation and runtime encryption for proprietary agent instructions
summary: Build an asset compilation and encryption pipeline that compiles agent prompts and persona templates into Go binary assets via embed.FS or encrypted asset packages with runtime license-key-derived decryption.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_capabilities.py, core/agent_card_loader.py, core/agent_hierarchy.py, core/agent_ledger.py

approach: Implement compile_prompts() pipeline that packages prompt markdown files into encrypted .bin bundles and catalogs them in EAP manifest.
rollback: Disable prompt compilation in packaging flags to fall back to standard asset packaging.
objective: Build a secure prompt compiler and runtime packaging layer that compiles proprietary agent instructions into encrypted asset bundles in EAP distributions.

api_impact.reason: Packaging, deployment, and verification CLI/core capability; no dedicated HTTP routes required

verification: Automated test suite verifying AES-256 encryption, decryption round-trip, and fail-closed corrupt bundle rejection.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Prompt asset compiler tokenizes and encrypts persona definitions using AES-256-GCM authenticated cipher with runtime key derivation.
AC-2: Shipped customer packages contain zero readable system prompt files or plaintext markdown instructions in distributions.
AC-3: Runtime agent adapter transparently decrypts and loads compiled prompt bundles in memory with zero plaintext disk leakage.
